description:
Does a B. napus pangenome gene's presence/absence go with a trait? For accessions of the UWA B. napus pangenome
(53 accessions) that also have BnIR population phenotypes (matched by name; about 30, mostly the Bus et al. 2011
set), compares trait values of accessions carrying vs lacking the gene (Mann-Whitney U, per trait record). gene: a
pangenome, Ensembl v4.1 or ZS11 gene ID (as pangenome_gene); trait: words as in bnapus_phenotypes. Small groups:
exploratory only, population structure is not corrected; a core gene (present in all) cannot be tested.
name: pangenome_gene_trait
